summary: Iteration 13 - Recovery Services directory. Backend 17/17 pytest PASS (100%). Frontend all critical flows PASS: public unauth sign-in gate renders correct h1, authenticated admin sees Local Recovery Services list with 1 service (Recovery Lab Denver), List/Map toggle works, Leaflet map renders with 1 marker (react-leaflet v4 downgrade is working), detail page shows discount + location + map, admin list table shows status badge (Published), eye toggle, edit pencil, delete trash icons, admin new form has all required fields (name, category select, description, discount, Add Location btn), admin edit page pre-populates with existing service data. Regression: home, shop, admin dashboard all load OK; admin sub-pages (products/hcp/discounts) were not verified due to Cloudflare verification challenge appearing mid-test (testing artifact, not a bug).

console_errors.issue: Recurring page-level error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading \'match\')' fires on EVERY route navigation (home, /recovery-services, /admin, /admin/recovery-services, /admin/recovery-services/new, etc.). Pages still render correctly so it is non-blocking, but this is an unhandled exception in the app and should be investigated. Most likely candidate: a wouter route param or a regex .match() call where the input value is undefined on first render. Search the codebase for `.match(` calls and verify all inputs are guarded.

critical_code_review_comments: recovery_services.py:33 - memberDiscount returned as {locked: true, hasDiscount: bool} for non-members is a clean approach.
recovery_services.py:119,165,189,210,225 - InvalidId is caught and converted to 404, consistent across endpoints. Good.

recovery_services.py:171-176 - On UPDATE the approvedAt is only stamped on draft->published transition; if a published service is updated again, approvedAt is preserved (not overwritten because the new `update` dict omits it but $set will keep DB values). VERIFY: actually, $set with the `update` dict will not modify keys not in the dict, so approvedAt stays. OK.

recovery_services.py:55-68 - _build_doc does not validate category against RECOVERY_CATEGORIES enum (the spec mentions 'one of RECOVERY_CATEGORIES'). Any string is accepted. Consider server-side validation.
Frontend: the recurring `.match()` undefined error needs root-cause; could be tied to a useLocation or useRoute call without a fallback.
